g1-implement.title: The join module + gating tests: implement
g1-implement.imperative: Fill templates/IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md and dispatch constellation-implementer via run_crew.py. Build src/physics/fingerprint/join.py: a PURE function join_weekend_prior(composition: Mapping[str,float], cells: Sequence[FingerprintCell], vocabulary: ClassVocabulary, *, as_of_round: int, nu_loss: float = DEFAULT_NU_LOSS, rule: TailRule = FormulaRule(), map_version: Optional[str] = None) -> WeekendUtilizationPrior. The join is a NORMALIZED WEIGHTED AVERAGE over the k severity classes: select comp_i = composition[class_id] for each class_id in vocabulary.class_ids (do NOT renormalize the input; corner_share = Σ comp_i, which is NOT 1.0); weights w_i = comp_i / corner_share; prior_mean = Σ w_i m_i over resolved cells (unresolved cells fall back to the resolved-weighted mean μ_res so they never silently shift the mean); σ propagation: combined_scale = sqrt( Σ_res w_i² σ_i²  +  (weight_on_thin × σ_unres)² ) — QUADRATURE, pinned. σ_unres (the fat scale for the unresolved weight) MUST be able to EXCEED the resolved cells' σ (the whole honest-σ point is that an UNKNOWN class inflates uncertainty beyond known dispersion): derive σ_unres = max( cross-class spread of the resolved cell MEANS (population std, or range/2), max_resolved_σ ) — a DERIVED value, never a new frozen literal; this guarantees an unresolved class widens, never caps, the prior. n_eff MUST fold in the thin weight so the TAIL fattens (not just the scale): use the effective sample size of the weighted mean over resolved cells, n_eff_res = 1 / Σ_res (w_i² / support_i) (a weight-aware effective count — NO arbitrary 'meaningfully-weighted' threshold), then reduce it by the thin exposure, n_eff = n_eff_res × (1 − weight_on_thin), floored just above NU_FLOOR-territory so predictive_t stays valid. Wrap into a PredictiveT via predictive_t(mean=prior_mean, sigma=combined_scale, n_eff=n_eff, nu_loss=nu_loss, rule=rule). NOTE the independent-cell assumption (Var=Σw²σ² treats classes as uncorrelated, shrinking scale ~1/√k under averaging) — state it honestly in the module docstring as a Build-1 simplification, do NOT claim full correlation-honesty. WeekendUtilizationPrior (frozen dataclass) carries: driver, channel, prior (PredictiveT | None), mean, corner_share, class_ids, weights, resolved_mask, thin_classes (tuple of class_ids leaning on unresolved cells), weight_on_thin (summed normalized weight on unresolved classes), as_of_round, vocabulary_version, map_version, share_provenance='time'. LOUD refusals (no silent substitution): every cell.vocabulary_version must equal vocabulary.vocabulary_id AND cell.channel identical across cells AND cell class_ids equal vocabulary.class_ids in order (else ValueError naming the mismatch); a class_id in vocabulary.class_ids absent from composition refuses; corner_share <= 0 refuses (no corner exposure); ZERO resolved cells ⇒ return a fully-thin prior (prior=None, weight_on_thin=1.0, thin_classes=all) surfaced loudly, NEVER a fabricated value. Do NOT read the #664/#666 stores inside this function (pure — the caller passes composition + cells). Also write tests/unit/physics/fingerprint/test_join.py covering, EXACTLY: (T7-1) uniform composition across classes ⇒ prior_mean == the UNWEIGHTED arithmetic mean of the k cell means — the join-level 'driver-overall mean' (document explicitly that at the pure-join level the driver-overall mean IS the unweighted mean of the k cells; the fit-hierarchy driver-overall pool.grand_mean+team_effect is a DIFFERENT, support-weighted quantity the pure join has no access to — see triage note); (T7-2) all cells identical ⇒ prior_mean == that constant for ANY composition vector; (T7-3) single-class circuit (one class nonzero share) ⇒ combined scale collapses to that cell's σ and prior_mean == that cell's mean; (T7-4) soft memberships flow through unchanged and corner_share == Σ input shares (NOT renormalized to 1.0); (T7-5) NON-DEGENERATE GENERAL CASE (the real mechanically-broken-join catch, since T7-1..4 are all degenerate and survive a comp↔cell mis-pairing / sign / ordering bug): DISTINCT shares AND DISTINCT cell means, assert prior_mean == the hand-computed Σ_i (comp_i/Σcomp)·m_i to full precision, and assert a wrong-normalization (dividing by k, or renormalizing comp to 1.0) would give a DIFFERENT number here; PLUS σ-propagation monotonicity (a fatter-σ cell widens the prior), a NUMERIC thin-widening assertion (the SAME inputs with one class UNRESOLVED yield a STRICTLY WIDER prior scale than all-resolved — proves the unresolved path fattens, not caps, σ — this guards the BLOCKER the cold critic flagged), thin/unresolved surfacing (unresolved class appears in thin_classes with its weight in weight_on_thin; resolved-only ⇒ thin_classes empty, weight_on_thin==0.0), both-channels symmetry (utilization + energy join identically given identical inputs), and the loud-refusal cases. Consume DEFAULT_NU_LOSS/FormulaRule/predictive_t from src.common.student_t; FINGERPRINT_FROZEN if any frozen value is needed (mint NO literal). Export join_weekend_prior + WeekendUtilizationPrior from the fingerprint package __init__ if that matches the package convention. Wait for and integrate IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.
